summary: Iteration 47: Zelle Payment System Backend Testing Complete - All 12 Zelle payment endpoints verified working correctly. 19/19 pytest tests passed. This iteration tested the NEW Zelle payment system that replaced Stripe Connect.

frontend_issues.note: Frontend testing skipped as requested - React Native/Expo app

GET /api/settings/zelle.description: Public endpoint returns platform Zelle info (ashtonbundy1@gmail.com / 240-281-0462)

PUT /api/admin/settings/zelle.description: Admin can update Zelle settings, non-admin blocked (403)

POST /api/payments/zelle/mark-sent.description: Trainee marks payment as sent, requires auth, validates session ownership

POST /api/admin/payments/verify-zelle/{s.description: Admin verifies Zelle payment, session becomes confirmed

GET /api/admin/payments/pending-zelle.description: Admin sees pending Zelle payments with trainee info

POST /api/trainer/zelle-info.description: Trainer saves Zelle email/phone for receiving payouts

GET /api/trainer/zelle-info.description: Trainer retrieves their Zelle info with hasZelleInfo flag

GET /api/admin/payouts/pending.description: Shows trainers with Zelle info, pending balances, $35 minimum

POST /api/admin/payouts/pay-trainer.description: Marks trainer as paid via Zelle (validates trainer exists)

critical_code_review_comments: All 12 Zelle payment endpoints are working correctly
Proper authorization checks in place (admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admins)
Session ownership validation works (trainee can only mark-sent their own sessions)
Zelle settings seeded on startup with default values
Payout minimum correctly set to $35 (3500 cents)
Old Stripe Connect endpoints have been removed as expected
